D.t: Ben Ray Luján leads by 21.1 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 172,468 votes; a one point swing is about 4,093 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +12.9 and D +29.2. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
The polls page average is D +16.1. Your best recent poll is SurveyUSA for KOB 4 at D +17.4; your worst is Research & Polling Inc. at D +17.0. 2 polls in the last 30 days.

The biggest vote banks for Democrats: Bernalillo, a projected net 103,046 votes; Santa Fe, a projected net 49,518 votes; Doña Ana, a projected net 20,430 votes. Every point of extra turnout here is worth more than persuasion anywhere else.
The large counties within 12 points: Valencia, R +1.5, 3.5% of the vote; Luna, R +4.3, 0.9% of the vote; Colfax, D +2.1, 0.6% of the vote; Sierra, R +8.2, 0.6% of the vote.

D.t: Against the 2024 presidential vote, Ben Ray Luján runs furthest behind in Lea, Eddy, Curry. That is where the forecast sees voters who backed your side two years ago and have not come back yet.

Groups big enough to move the race: Voters who cast ballots in 2022 and 2024, 66% of voters, 61 to 39, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.27 points; Voters without a degree, 61% of voters, 59 to 41, where a 5 point gain is worth 3.05 points; White voters, 58% of voters, 55 to 45, where a 5 point gain is worth 2.90 points.
